name: voyager_status
description: Read Voyager service status. Registration, runtime, capture and conversation state are different.

name: voyager_vessels
description: List registered Vessels with exact IDs, names, kind, rank, assignment, runtime and window state. Resolve targets by ID, never guess.

name: voyager_create
description: Create and register one real Codex or Bash Vessel. Opens its Ghostty terminal unless open is false. Crew is the normal default rank. Poll the returned request with voyager_operation; starting is not completion.

name: voyager_send
description: Send a bounded instruction to one registered Codex Vessel. Starts a turn when idle or steers the current turn. Acceptance is not completed work. Never silently resend an uncertain instruction.

name: voyager_operation
description: Read the saved outcome of an action or instruction. Poll this instead of repeating its action.

name: voyager_events
description: Read captured work events after a cursor for a Vessel. Look for its actual native turn completion and errors.

name: voyager_open
description: Open or surface the same Vessel terminal without creating another runtime.

name: voyager_background
description: Close a Vessel terminal while its runtime and capture continue.

name: voyager_stop
description: Stop the owned Vessel and close its terminal, retaining registration and history. Only use when the human requested stopping that work.

name: voyager_remove
description: Deregister a Vessel, ending future capture; historic events remain. stop=true also stops and closes it. Only remove when the human requested it.

name: voyager_rank
description: Set an agent rank at the owner’s request. Existing assignments must remain valid.

name: voyager_supervise
description: Assign a Vessel to an adjacent higher rank, or null to clear its supervisor. Fleet grouping does not grant authority.

name: voyager_shell
description: Run one command in a registered Bash Vessel, respecting human input exclusion.

name: voyager_fleets
description: List named Fleet goals and explicit membership roots. Descendants follow their supervisor’s Fleet unless explicitly moved.

name: voyager_create_fleet
description: Create a Fleet for a short goal. It is a presentation group, not an authority level.

name: voyager_move_to_fleet
description: Move a Vessel and its assigned descendants into a Fleet, or null back to Vessels. Does not change authority.

name: voyager_remove_fleet
description: Remove a presentation Fleet while preserving its Vessels and running work.

name: voyager_escalations
description: Read questions routed to the human, including original messages and answered/delivery state. Resolve stale questions before acting.

name: voyager_answer
description: Forward the human’s latest actual words unchanged to one unanswered escalation. Use only when those words explicitly answer this question. For ambiguity or multiple possible targets ask for clarification. This records an answer and delivery, not task completion or a fabricated approval.
